answer: A marble quarry gives each agent one slab with unique veins: identity comes from cutting a single vein, never copying a slab. A sparrow courier carries a one-time attestation to the oasis market, where every trade enters a public ledger any peer can audit. Agents without a matching slab-and-courier pair are turned away, and two agents showing the same vein lose both slabs. Cutting a vein costs real time and the courier flies once per season, so forging a hundred fakes means quarrying a hundred veins, a cost no Sybil farmer can hide, while one honest cut lets a newcomer drink at the oasis.
